system.description:
When you have a few minutes of calm
to focus, you can spend 2 Hope to
deploy, unlock, or reveal your
Safehouse, a large hidden shelter,
mobile base, bunker, or concealed
operational room where you and your
allies can take shelter.
When you do, a hidden entrance
appears somewhere within Close
range. Once inside, you can make the
entrance invisible. You and anyone else
inside can always exit. Once you leave,
the doorway must be deployed again.
When you take a rest within your own
Safehouse, you can choose an
additional downtime move.
